[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Matrix and shifts** [CF 1660E · Matrix and Shifts](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1660/E){rating="1600"}

A free shift moves every cell by the same offset on a torus, so it never changes which cells share a **wrapped diagonal** $(j - i) \bmod n$ — it only decides which wrapped diagonal lands on the main one. Pick the wrapped diagonal with the most ones, $\textit{best}$: the cost is $(n - \textit{best})$ flips to fill it plus $(\textit{total} - \textit{best})$ flips to clear every other one.

[Solved in full in @sec-mat-p5-shifts.]{.card-link}

:::
